subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw add core trusted workspace-agent discovery, or keep agent registration explicit through central config and existing agent-management RPCs?
rationale: The request adds new config, filesystem scanning, trust boundaries, precedence rules, and live routing semantics; source inspection can show the gap but cannot choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Keep Explicit Registration
options.body: Continue using central config and `agents.create/update/delete`, and route dynamic workspace discovery to docs/operator tooling unless a smaller missing API is proven.

options.title: Design Trusted Discovery
options.body: Define trusted roots, file patterns, precedence, validation, reload semantics, and security proof before implementing `agents.autoDiscover` or similar.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Registration
recommendation.body: Continue using central config and `agents.create/update/delete`, and route dynamic workspace discovery to docs/operator tooling unless a smaller missing API is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest current-source and gateway protocol history signal on the central agent config and gateway-management paths.
